title: Freeze independent CCP2 complete-airtime cases
description:
Scope: CCP2 airtime and complete-operation fixture cases in /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/test/vectors/, using the independently stated Semtech formula and anchors in /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/docs/ccp-conformance.md. Calculate full PHY length, setup/retune/CCA, any explicitly reserved response, one trailing guard, boundary rounding and insufficient slack. Include corrected narrowband/LDRO and 300 ms arithmetic solely as feasibility evidence. Do not call the production airtime implementation or enable experimental PHY/security/fragmentation modes.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Reuse focused independent arithmetic where available; no general RF simulator is needed. Keep emitted airtime separate from non-emitting setup/guard occupation and do not invent a universal link ACK.
acceptance_criteria: Independent integer/rational calculations pin SF10/BW125k 100-byte airtime to 1.026048 s and 255-byte airtime to 2.295808 s; frame plus 50 ms guard rounds up to 2346 ms before other operation costs. Exact-fit and one-unit-late cases are explicit. Narrowband uses applicable LDRO; 300 ms maxima SF7/8/9/10 are 187/98/44/14 complete PHY bytes and SF11/12 cannot fit an empty packet. Existing 62-byte signed-broadcast overhead is counted, not hidden as application payload.
